findings.title: Alias dialog assertions do not distinguish action semantics
findings.failure: Returning the schedule dialog for both keep and reactivate still passes, despite presenting the wrong action, button, and consequences.
findings.correction: Use explicit per-action expectations for titles, buttons, and distinguishing description content, including preservation of the current Handle where applicable.

findings.title: Polling and owner-cache clearing share an unrelated test

test.quote: it('pauses import polling during writes and purges only resolved session transitions', () => {

findings.failure: A polling assertion failure prevents the independent owner-clearing checks from running, coupling diagnosis and maintenance of two separate policies.
findings.correction: Split polling and owner-clearing expectations into separately named tests.

findings.title: No independent valid fixture proves HMAC interoperability
findings.failure: Encode and decode could both switch to another keyed calculation producing 64 hexadecimal characters and still pass. Independently signed fixtures all contain invalid payloads, so rejecting them does not establish compatibility with valid HMAC-SHA256 cursors.
findings.correction: Decode a valid cursor built by the independent signed helper and compare an encoded cursor's signature with an independently calculated HMAC.

findings.title: Blank-input rejection and absence of writes are untested

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: An implementation that writes an empty string and returns Saved for blank input passes the sole nonblank scenario.
findings.correction: Add a blank-input scenario asserting Invalid and an empty write-call log.

findings.title: Pending interval is compared with itself

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Returning any stable incorrect value for idle pending polling passes this assertion; the other test does not check that outcome.
findings.correction: Assert that poll('pending', false) equals the independent contractual value 5000.

findings.title: Editor test asserts private storage instead of public value

support.quote: Private storage representation may change without breaking clients.

findings.failure: Renaming storage breaks the test despite unchanged public behavior, while a broken public getter can pass.

findings.title: Opaque scenario keys hide the polling contract
findings.failure: The caller cannot explain any scenario's inputs or expected result without opening the helper; failures in the shared assertion also lack meaningful scenario names.
findings.correction: Declare explicit status, writing, and expected tuples at the call site and pass them to the helper.

findings.title: Independent polling and ownership checks are coupled

support.quote: Polling and session ownership are independent policies.

findings.failure: A polling failure prevents all ownership assertions from executing and gives both policies one diagnostic identity.
findings.correction: Separate polling behavior and session ownership into independently named tests.

findings.title: Identity wrapper repeats the complete polling matrix

support.quote: A higher-level identity wrapper adds no translation, synchronization or browser risk.

findings.failure: Every policy change produces duplicate wider-boundary failures without testing a distinct integration risk.
findings.correction: Keep the complete matrix at the public poll boundary and remove its repetition through the identity wrapper.
